fieldValues.title: One chain of meaning for essays and the programme
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The owner, 2026-10-16: an essay speaks about a domain, the problems personas face there, claims and remedies, the same chain the programme has learned to walk (domain, persona-in-domain, problem, cluster, remedy). The writing tools should link to that chain as the essay is written.
fieldValues.tensions: Two models already describe it. muSrs uses the argument package: boundary (with scopes-problem), problem, claim, option. The programme uses the method package: domain, persona, persona-in-domain, problem, cluster, remedy. Alongside them sit boundaries, tensions and archetypes. One way per goal would push to converge now; the owner's method for this phase is the opposite: practise them side by side and resist collapsing them too soon. The editor must work in any repository, whichever packages it carries.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: 1. Is a muSrs boundary the same thing as a method domain? 2. Is an argument option a remedy? 3. Do personas enter muSrs, or stay in the programme? 4. Does the essay package link to the method types, the argument types, or a shared core both map onto?
fieldValues.blocking: Nothing yet: the essay map can start with the links muSrs already has. It blocks once an essay needs to link a remedy or a persona.
fieldValues.next_action: Hold both models while they are practised; do not converge yet. Record where an essay or the programme strains against one model or the other, as evidence. Bring a side-by-side to a session only when that evidence shows which way to unify.
